entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • The `Complext` property does not work with raw SQL #38461
  • JSON collection mapped to nullable reference collection fails on JSON `null` token (`Invalid token type: 'Null'`) #38454
    11.0.0

Closed

  • Bad relationship leads to data loss #38455
  • Removing a migration adds a `(string)null` argument to all ToTable calls in the snapshot #26067
    11.0.0
  • Compiled Model fails when discriminator uses non-primitive type (SmartEnum); cannot scaffold C# literals #37259
    11.0.0
  • Compile generated UnsafeAccessors classes don't match underlying class accessibility level #35013
    11.0.0
  • Compile generated EntityType classes are susceptible to variable name clashes #35011
    11.0.0
  • EF Core 9 generates incorrect compiled models for negative enum sentinel values #35142
    11.0.0
  • Compiled model's CreateRelationalModel() fails when model contains owned entity #37981
    11.0.0
  • Old migration break in EF Core 8 that worked in EF Core 7 and previous #33734
    11.0.0
  • EF Core Json Column Update Fails When Updating Date-Related Fields in Owned Navigation Property #35646
    11.0.0
  • Allow TPH classes to map different owned classes to same JSON column #38457
  • Move some of the Design services to Relational #37293
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Emit N prefix for xml string literals in SQL Server #38460
  • Handle JSON null token when reading collections mapped to JSON #38459
  • Fix precompiled query generation for shadow property names that are not valid C# identifiers #38458
  • Unload target assemblies before publishing the migrations bundle #38456
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38453

Merged

  • Suppress redundant `[Stage]` diff line for added/removed types in API diff comment #38444
  • Fix SQL Server password in copilot-setup-steps.yml #38445
  • Fix redundant (string)null schema argument in ToTable snapshot generation #38424
  • Fix several small issues in the compiled model #38441
  • Fix compiled-model CreateRelationalModel() failure when an owned entity shares its owner's table #38428
  • Fix NullReferenceException for mistyped default values on non-string columns in migrations #38399
  • Use string type mapping when sending null values for JSON column update on SQL Server #38426
  • Move IOperationReporter, ISnapshotModelProcessor and SnapshotModelProcessor to EFCore.Relational as public API #38408
    api-review

Updated

  • Don't transform Cosmos query to ReadItem when WithPartitionKey conflicts with predicate partition key #38439
  • Better cast/convert support for Cosmos #35000
    community-contribution
  • Validate that ownership relationships keep their default DeleteBehavior and requiredness #38448
  • Make model snapshots with mismatched FK/PK property types usable #38450
  • Throw by default for multiple owned entities set to the same instance #38446
  • Keep nullable outer-key null check in compound APPLY→JOIN predicates #38449
  • Fix migration generation for non-nullable SqlVector columns #38451
  • Fix inverting identifying FK using wrong type and short-circuit principal type on attach #38423
  • Mark entities as unchanged when matched by entities loaded from database #38452
